subject: Mutual plan kickoff: security review & SOC 2 evidence deliverables
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan kickoff: security review & SOC 2 evidence deliverables

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed mutual plan items so we have alignment on owners and dates. Pulling in Marissa (engagement lead) and Neha (security) to drive the artifacts.

TL;DR milestones (proposed):
- May 25: Redwood delivers SOC 2 questionnaire (v1) to Acme (owner: Redwood, assignee: Marissa Cole)
- May 28: Evidence checklist & template (owner: Redwood, assignee: Marissa)
- May 31: Security review call (Redwood security + Acme security) to validate gaps (owner: Acme to provide attendee list)
- Jun 15: Target internal signoff on security items
- Jun 30: Target commercial close (flexible, depends on procurement/legal)

Dependencies we heard on the call: Acme needs encryption/KMS details, access to log retention policy, and a point of contact for vendor security for any platform scans. If procurement/legal windows push, we can shift close date — please flag ASAP.

Next steps:
1) I will attach a draft mutual plan (see attached mutual-plan-v1.pdf) and the questionnaire + checklist will follow from Marissa by Tues (May 25).
2) Samir: please confirm target close window and who will join the security review call (title + email) by EOD Mon.
3) We propose a 30‑minute security sync on Wed May 26 or Thu May 27 — Neha, can you host?

Attachments: mutual-plan-v1.pdf (outline of milestones)

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0189

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement window: our commercial & legal review cycle typically takes ~3 weeks after we receive the SOC 2 artifacts. If we get the questionnaire and evidence checklist this week, we can aim for a June 30 close but July 15 is a safer target.
- Security asks: we will need details on key management (KMS/HSM), network egress controls, and the list of logs retained and retention periods. Can you confirm whether audit logs for admin actions are retained for 12+ months?
- Dependencies: our SOC 2 reviewer will request role-based access mappings and at least one week of synthetic logs for the services in scope. We will provide the reviewer contact in the next email.

I attached a short doc with our security baseline for vendor reviews (Acme_Security_Reqs.pdf) — please review and call out any items you cannot meet.

For now, please send the questionnaire and checklist as proposed. I can confirm attendees for the security review by Monday EOD.

Best,
Samir Patel
Director, Vendor Security | Acme Health Systems

- Control: Encryption at rest — Evidence: KMS configuration screenshots + key rotation policy, owner: Acme Cloud Ops, due: 2027-05-28
- Control: Audit logs — Evidence: sample log archive (7 days) + retention policy document, owner: Acme Platform, due: 2027-05-28
- Control: Incident response — Evidence: incident runbook + contact list, owner: Acme Security, due: 2027-06-04

Proposed meeting windows for security review (30 mins):
- Wed, May 26: 10:00–10:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu, May 27: 14:00–14:30 PT

If those work, we will share a short agenda and dial-in.

Samir / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from the security side before the sync: 

1) Can you confirm whether your KMS is customer-managed or vendor-managed and which cloud provider key type you use (KMS/HSM)? We need the key rotation policy and whether envelope encryption is used.
2) Please provide a sanitized sample of admin/audit logs (one week) or a screencap of the retention dashboard. If you cannot share logs, the retention policy doc plus export method is sufficient for our initial review.
3) For the vendor scanner, please nominate an IP allowlist or a staging endpoint we can use to run a non-intrusive scan.

Proposed security sync: Wed, May 26 at 10:00 PT — Marissa will send the invite. Goal is to validate the checklist items and confirm final due dates. After the call we'll update the mutual plan and circulate the finalized milestone table.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Lead | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
